head_commit.message:
Merge PR #105: Rift Forge expansion into development

Integrate the twenty-track Rift Forge expansion after exact-head full, Lab and Forge CI success and independent raw-artifact verification. Full run 38047024745: 182 scenarios, 212 PASS rows, 22 required negative controls. Lab 38047024763 and Forge 38047024764 passed on the same combined tree dd9e503000291554af6e93c294d99d475a09612f. Preserve existing saves, purchases, progression and Auto-Ascend. Development branch only; main and APK publication remain held.
